title: docs(spec): meta-read organizationId describes stop promising a supplied org is always consulted (#16524)
body:
Fixes #16524

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Three published `.describe()` strings in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, the `organizationId` member of:

| schema | was | now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GetMetaItemRequestSchema` | "Selects the org partition in the ADR-0005 overlay read order … Absent = environment-wide read: only env-level overlays apply and no org partition is consulted." | "When an org partition applies, this selects it in the ADR-0005 overlay read order … Supplying a value does not by itself guarantee an org partition is consulted; where none applies, and whenever it is absent, the read is environment-wide and only env-level overlays apply." |
| `GetMetaItemLayeredRequestSchema` | "Selects the org partition … Absent = environment-wide read: `overlay` reports the env-level row only." | "When an org partition applies, this selects it … Supplying a value does not by itself guarantee an org partition is consulted; where none applies, and whenever it is absent, the read is environment-wide: `overlay` reports the env-level row only." |
| `GetMetaItemCachedRequestSchema` | "Selects the org partition … exactly as on the uncached read. Also folded into the ETag, … Absent = environment-wide read." | "When an org partition applies, this selects it … exactly as on the uncached read. Also folded into the ETag, … Supplying a value does not by itself guarantee an org partition is consulted; where none applies, and whenever it is absent, the read is environment-wide." |

Plus the regenerated `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (three table rows) and an `@objectstack/spec` **patch** changeset.

Prose only: no key, export, accept set or runtime behaviour changes. A supplied `organizationId` is still accepted on all three requests, and the runtime still drops it where no org partition applies.

## Rulings carried

- Ruling B (comment 5567936958), maintainer, verbatim: 「协议不对不是应该修改协议吗？」. The describes are protocol text, so they are corrected now. The wording qualifies the promise, states the negative, names neither `allowOrgOverride` nor the registry (no registry clause), and adds no key. Its shape matches the sibling `GetMetaItemsRequestSchema.organizationId` row reworded in PR #16523, so the four meta-read rows now read the same way.
- Scope ruling (comment 5807019811), maintainer, verbatim: 「16524 改文档,不需要按组织取」. This PR changes published text only: no runtime change, and no refusal of a supplied `organizationId`.
- Measured correction (comment 5612706063): on `GetMetaItemCachedRequestSchema` only the opening sentence overstated. The ETag sentence ("Also folded into the ETag, so a scope switch never returns a stale 304 from another scope's cached representation.") is true, is pinned by PR #17292, and is **kept byte-for-byte**. Its source line does not appear in this diff.

## Premise re-verified on today's tree

Measured on `84880f9` (BASE); the merge of `369bcbed` touched no file below.

- The gate is `organizationIdForMetaRead` (`packages/metadata-core/src/meta-write-org-scope.ts:184`). It returns `undefined` unless `declaresOrgOverride(type)` holds.
- `getMetaItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) reads `request.organizationId` only through the gate (`:8123`). A gated-away value resolves `findDraft(null)` (`:8161`) and `findOverlay(null)` (`:8227`-`:8228`), which are env-level.
- `getMetaItemLayered` gates at `:8633`. `if (orgId)` at `:8728` skips the org overlay read entirely, and only `findOverlay(null)` runs.
- `getMetaItemCached` delegates to `getMetaItem` (`:12199`), so the same drop applies. The ETag folds the *supplied* value (`:12294`), so the kept ETag sentence stays true.

The runtime still behaves as the ruling describes, so no stop was needed.

## Verification

All at head `3388f2920` (branch merged with `origin/main` `369bcbed`), unless noted. Every heavy run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, and each result is the `VERDICT command-exit` line.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated`: before `--fix`, exactly 1 of 15 artefacts was stale (`content/docs/references/**`). `--fix` regenerated that one, and the three `organizationId` rows in `protocol.mdx` are the only lines that moved. After the merge: "All 15 generated artifacts are up to date", exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 540 files, 15820 passed and 2 todo, exit 0. `src/api/protocol.test.ts` alone: 178 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts, and the test layer): exit 0.
- Compiled `dist` read back: the three new descriptions are present, "allowOrgOverride" and "registry" each count 0 in them, and the ETag sentence occurs verbatim once.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 101 commands, the same list before and after the merge. `--ran` reconciliation reads "101 derived, 100 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". All 100 that ran exited 0.
  - NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET). It needs every publishable package built: 33 still had no `dist/` after the closure build below, and CI's `Build Core` runs it. As a declared narrowing, I loaded every `require` entry of `@objectstack/spec`, the only package this diff rebuilds, under CJS: 23 of 23 loaded. The gate's own `--list` names 18 spec entries, all inside those 23. Every other package's dist is unaffected by string edits in `packages/spec/src`.
  - For five gates the first run refused with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (unbuilt `lint` / `formula` / `client-react` / `objectql`): `check:skill-examples`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:docs-transcript-drift` and `check:lean-entry-closure`. After a turbo build of that 34-task closure they ran green. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first refused on the shallow clone; it went green after a depth-1 fetch of its pinned fixture commit.
  - `check:dts-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` swept 1 built package, `@objectstack/spec`, which is the one this diff touches.
- ESLint (narrowed, a measurement rather than a skip): `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the three touched paths returns 3 entries. `protocol.zod.ts` has 0 errors and 0 warnings. The `.md` and `.mdx` answer "no matching configuration", which means they are outside the population defined by `eslint.config.mjs`'s `files` globs. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, zero `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- No pin test is added. These strings are prose that no consumer parses, and pinning their wording would only freeze the wording.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts:1599`-`1602`, a test comment, still says the implementation "accepts and HONOURS `organizationId` on all four read verbs: it selects the org partition … it decides which tenant's row is served". That is the same overstatement, in an unpublished test comment. It is outside this card's claimed file surface, so I left it. Carrier: none.
- Draft PR #19637 also regenerates `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`. Whichever PR lands second regenerates that file; the file is routed to the `os-regen` merge driver.
